cohort: 13,701 premature infants born in the Department of Neonatology of 14 hospitals from major cities in 11 provinces of China, between January 2013 and December 2014.
finding: Prenatal dexamethasone may effectively reduce the incidence of RDS and improve prognosis in preterm neonates with GA < 33 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were significantly associated with RDS in premature infants.
